mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (both HOUST and RSAFS declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 850,000 units (HOUST < 850), it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (both PAYEMS declining and UNRATE rising) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05) in a 5-year rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days as valuations become stretched and the risk of a slowdown increases.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and rising over 3 months
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
